fields.label: Evapotranspiration Fractions
fields.help: The default values (0.35 for non-wetlands, 0.4 for wetlands) likely are low values for most locations (the U.S. national average is around 0.70). They were selected so that more of the precipitation would contribute to modeled runoff, thus delivering additional deposited chemical to modeled water bodies.

fields.label: Groundwater Seepage Fractions
fields.help: The default values of 0.25 for non-wetland parcels and 0 for wetland parcels were selected from professional judgment.

fields.label: Runoff Fractions
fields.help: The default values (0.4 for non-wetlands, 0.6 for wetlands) were selected from professional judgment and are intended to deliver additional deposited chemical to modeled water bodies.
